title: There’s No Wave Function? | Jacob Barandes
summary: Physicist Jacob Barandes discusses his view that quantum mechanics can be formulated without wave functions, using a stochastic, probabilistic approach. The long interview covers measurement, the foundations of quantum theory and the history of the field.
why: HN commenters point to it as a credible, clearly explained alternative take on quantum foundations from a Harvard physicist.

quote.text: Barandes is excellent at clearly articulating complex ideas in very simple, concise terms.
